de: In England, the Yorkists under Edward IV defeat the Lancastrians under the Earl of Warwick at the Battle of Barnet; the Earl is killed and Edward resumes the throne.

te: The Battle of Tewkesbury: Edward IV defeats a Lancastrian Army and kills Edward of Westminster, Prince of Wales.
dz: 玫瑰战争：图克斯伯里之战：爱德华四世击败兰开斯特军队并杀死威尔士亲王威斯敏斯特的爱德华。
de: Wars of the Roses: The Battle of Tewkesbury: Edward IV defeats a Lancastrian Army and kills Edward of Westminster, Prince of Wales.

dz: 长老斯滕·斯图尔(Sten Sture the Elder),瑞典摄政,在农民和矿工的帮助下,击退了丹麦国王克里斯蒂安一世的一次进攻.
de: Sten Sture the Elder, the Regent of Sweden, with the help of farmers and miners, repels an attack by King Christian I of Denmark.
